verdict.rationale: Rippling documents custom workflows that are triggered by events, such as notifying people of changes or sending a Slack alert based on a Zendesk ticket. Nothing in the pack shows a way to schedule jobs or workflows on a recurring basis. 'Run payroll on your schedule' refers to payroll frequency, and 'recurring' pay types are pay settings; both are adjacent features, not scheduled workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
